tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

stories.title: Complete First-Time User Onboarding Journey with Contextual Guidance
stories.goal: complete the entire onboarding process from account creation to active league participation with clear guidance at each step
stories.benefit: I understand FSHQ's features and successfully join my league without confusion or getting stuck
acceptanceCriteria: System guides user through sequential onboarding flow: Register → Verify Email → Link League → Claim Role → Join League
Each step displays contextual help explaining what to do and why it matters with progress indicator showing completion percentage
User receives welcome email after registration with verification link and overview of next steps
After email verification, system automatically redirects to league linking page with clear instructions
System provides inline examples for finding Sleeper League ID (URL format, where to look in Sleeper app)
After successful league link, system explains role types (Manager vs Fan) with visual cards showing permissions for each
System displays pending approval status with expected wait time and notification preferences
Upon approval, system sends notification email and displays celebration modal with 'Getting Started' tips
First login after approval shows guided tour of main pages: Newsfeed, Power Rankings, Matchups, Transactions
System tracks onboarding completion metrics: time to complete each step, abandonment points, successful completion rate
User can access 'Onboarding Guide' from help menu to review steps or restart tour at any time

stories.title: Detect and Assist Stuck Onboarding Users
stories.goal: receive proactive assistance when I'm stuck or delayed in the onboarding process
stories.benefit: I can overcome obstacles and complete onboarding without needing to contact support
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when user has been in same onboarding step for more than 48 hours
System sends reminder email with step-specific help content and FAQ links for common issues
If user doesn't verify email within 24 hours, system displays resend verification option on login page
If user fails to link league after 3 attempts, system offers troubleshooting guide with common error solutions
System tracks failed league linking attempts and suggests alternative approaches (contact league commissioner)
If role approval is pending for more than 7 days, system prompts user to contact commissioner with pre-filled message template
System displays progress-based encouragement messages: 'You're almost there! Just one more step'
Abandoned onboarding can be resumed from last completed step with no data loss
System provides 'Skip for now' option for non-critical steps with reminders to complete later
Analytics dashboard tracks common abandonment points and reasons for incomplete onboarding

stories.title: Personalize Post-Onboarding Experience Based on Role
stories.goal: see personalized content and features relevant to my role immediately after completing onboarding
stories.benefit: I can start engaging with league content that matters to me without learning irrelevant features
acceptanceCriteria: System customizes homepage based on claimed role showing role-specific quick actions and content
Manager role users see Commissioner Desk prominently in navigation with call-to-action to create first power rankings
Fan role users see emphasized Newsfeed and Matchups pages with prompt to make first pick'em predictions
System generates personalized first post suggestions based on role: Managers encouraged to introduce themselves as commissioner, Fans prompted to share team support
First-time dashboard displays 'Recommended Actions' widget with role-appropriate tasks: 'Publish your first power rankings' or 'Make your first prediction'
System sends week-appropriate onboarding tips via email: Sunday morning prediction reminders for Fans, Monday power rankings prompts for Managers
Navigation menu highlights newly available features with 'New' badges based on role permissions
System tracks first engagement metrics by role: time to first post, first commissioner publish, first pick'em submission
Users can switch roles if permissions change with seamless UI adaptation (Fan promoted to Manager)
Personalization settings allow users to customize which features are highlighted in their experience

stories.title: Track and Display Onboarding Success Metrics
stories.goal: monitor onboarding funnel performance and identify improvement opportunities
stories.benefit: we can optimize the onboarding experience to increase successful completions and reduce abandonment
acceptanceCriteria: System tracks funnel metrics for each onboarding step: started, completed, abandoned, average time
Dashboard displays conversion rates between steps: registration to verification (%), verification to league linking (%), league linking to approval (%)
System segments metrics by acquisition channel, league type, and device type (mobile vs desktop)
Analytics identify common failure points with detailed error logs and user feedback
System generates weekly onboarding report with trends, improvements, and recommended actions
Cohort analysis tracks long-term engagement of users by onboarding completion status
A/B testing framework allows testing different onboarding flows and measuring impact on completion rates
System correlates onboarding experience with long-term retention and engagement metrics
Heatmaps and session recordings available for analyzing user behavior during onboarding
Admin dashboard provides ability to manually assist stuck users or approve pending memberships in bulk

stories.title: Handle Multi-League Onboarding for Users in Multiple Leagues
stories.goal: efficiently link and manage multiple fantasy leagues without repeating entire onboarding
stories.benefit: I can quickly add additional leagues using my existing account and switch between them seamlessly
acceptanceCriteria: System allows adding additional leagues via 'Link New League' option in league selector
User completes streamlined onboarding for additional leagues: Link League → Claim Role → Await Approval (skips registration and email verification)
System displays all linked leagues in dropdown selector with visual indicators for active/selected league
Each league maintains separate role assignments allowing user to be Manager in one league and Fan in another
Navigation and content automatically update based on currently selected league context
System persists league selection preference across sessions with last-used league as default
User profile shows all linked leagues with join dates and role badges
Notifications are league-specific with clear indication of which league triggered the notification
System supports quick league switching via keyboard shortcut or mobile gesture
Analytics track multi-league usage patterns: number of leagues per user, cross-league engagement, league switching frequency
